versions.name: Camp Conley Clarke
versions.summary: An expansive Palmetto Area Council property near Gaffney, South Carolina, with a pond, open fields, and wooded natural areas, used for troop weekend camping, council camporees, Order of the Arrow events, and outdoor leadership training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Palmetto Area Council camp page, which lists Camp Conley Clarke as one of the council's two owned properties. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; classified conservatively as a weekend camping and training property; features unsurveyed.
